Leave enough column/row space for the widest line and line count of each diagram. Preserve existing carried edges semantically, translating their IDs/anchors to output IDs. If validation-error.json exists, read it and previous-output.json and correct the same stage result. Do not emit commentary outside JSON.

Cover chat/turn and reference binding, direct supplied edits versus generation, pinned parent checkpoint/CanvasView ancestry, independent child controllers/chats, progress/cancellation, persisted results and synchronization back to the parent. Reuse existing Saved CanvasViews and supplied-edit domain boundaries as read-only evidence; do not duplicate their detailed trees.

cells.explanation:
Stage C1 adds only N2: one central tree covering AgentChat turns and captured references, supplied edits versus managed generation, pinned CanvasView ancestry, independent child chats/controllers, progress/cancellation, and persisted results synchronized to the parent. Explicit component branches provide attachment points for later C2 expansion; no peripheral diagrams are introduced. Both parent ASCII strings are copied unchanged from previous-1.json. Their six carried connections retain their meaning with translated IDs and recounted 1-based anchors. The new connection starts at api-backend line 78, the AgentChatService component that owns generation orchestration and the child lifecycle through GenerationCanvasBridge. Positions accommodate the parents' 81/91-character widths and 102/99 lines.

Source support remains pinned to 81f05a2bf9efa2334985d2298dcbd7b044dc4c1e against baseline 03f2168deba364103c2450ca9b8168cd1fc9ddc5: application/mapping/agent-chat/agentChatService.ts:150-312 supports preparation, child launch, persistence, cancellation and synchronization; :350-415 supports turn binding and interruption; :533-553 supports completion and usage. chatDiagramTools.ts:62-87 and :216-267 support direct supplied operations and reference/version validation. generationCanvasBridge.ts:14-94 supports isolated controllers, serialized commands, retry receipts and persisted histories. application/mapping/agent/chatBindings.ts:3-22 supports captured turn bindings. domain/core/diagrams/canvasHistory.ts:298-343 supports the saved checkpoint, ancestry and finished-result import; canvasGeneration.ts:8-26 defines generation metadata and requests. infrastructure/mapping/agent-chat/chatStore.ts:6-23 supports serialized atomic file replacement. Existing C09/D00 Saved CanvasViews and C11/D04 supplied-edit detail remain read-only boundaries rather than duplicated trees. Revision construction, retention, controller application and catalog publication remain distinct. Headless child editing does not remove the live-browser dependency for parent capture/update. No source canvas was published, no DiffTree hunk IDs were invented, and N1/N3-N8 and future backend-authority consolidation are excluded.
